## 2800 - 2873

If Autocreate is checked, these exceptions will not automatically resolve.

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02800">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2800 Meter master characteristic comparisons differences</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02800">

Meter Master Characteristic Comparisons Differences exceptions are related to the limits that are defined in Master Data Validation for both Gas and Liquid Meters. Master Data Validation (also known as Contract and Inspection Comparisons) defines how a meter's characteristics should look when brought in from the field. Master Characteristics are typically created based on the last test report for a meter. The master characteristics can be configured to generate exceptions if there is a difference between the meter’s master characteristic and the meter characteristic.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02801">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />2801 MMCCD - Plate diameter changed</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="02801">

FLOWCAL will compare the Orifice Plate Diameter on the Meter Characteristic record to the Orifice Plate Diameter on the Master Characteristic record for that meter defined in Master Data Validation. If the value differs between the meter and master characteristic record, then an exception will be generated.

For example, if the Orifice Plate Diameter is set to 6 on the Meter Characteristic record, but the Master Characteristic record has Orifice Plate Diameter set to 6.25, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="02802">
